title.narrative: Effective HIV and TB Control Project in the Kyrgyz Republic - Kyrgyzstan (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Kyrgyzstan, TB/HIV, United Nations Development Programme (UNDP Kyrgyzstan)This program has the following goals: To minimize the impact of the HIV epidemic by reducing 30% of the incidence and mortality by 2027 compared to 2020, as a stage towards eliminating the epidemic in the Kyrgyz Republic by 2030.. Success of treatment among drug resistant forms of MDR-TB by 2026, 80% according to NTP-6.. The objectives of this program are: Ensure that 95% of people living with HIV (PLHIV) are aware of their HIV status.. Cover 95% of people living with HIV with antiretroviral therapy (ART) and achieve viral load suppression in 95% of people receiving ART by 2026.. To reduce the level of stigma and discrimination to less than 10% in government organizations providing HIV-related services to key populations and PLHIV.. Ensure coordination and sustainable financing of HIV response measures by gradually increasing the share of government funding for HIV/ prevention and treatment programs to 80% by 2026.. Ensure coordination and sustainable financing of TB response measures by gradually increasing the share of government funding for TB prevention and treatment programs to 50% by 2026.. To ensure universal access to timely and quality diagnosis and treatment of M/XDR-TB
